_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/bank.jsx BankReconciliation (L83-156) + openBankMatch (real-forms2.jsx L431). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx source. crumb* render the breadcrumb. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, baht U+0E3F). Values present in i18n-full.json.phrases resolve via tp(); values in _missing are NOT yet in i18n-full.json and are flagged for the Wave-2 i18n round (P2-WEB-15). importToast + reconcileToast fire as client-intent toasts — POST /bank/statements/import and POST /bank/reconcile exist in the contract but are NOT implemented by the API (bank.ts registers only 5 ops), so those actions are honest stubs. statementPrefix joins with the wire period. matchModalTitle opens the per-line suggestion picker (POST /bank/lines/{id}/match). closeBtn reuses the prototype 'ปิด'.
